name: Theodora
epithet: Queen of the Kingdom of Saramis
personality: Proud, merit-minded queen who wants strength enough to protect her people.
story: Daughter of the late King Sergio and half-sister to Dyan, she served years at Fort Zanbar, where the assassin Bartolome killed her father and took her right arm. She accepts a cursed prosthetic arm from Mahadu that grants power at the cost of a roughly 10-year lifespan and mental deterioration. Often called the Flame Lord most central to the overall plot.

personalSkill.name: Royal Resolve
personalSkill.effect: Unit takes half damage when attacked (30% trigger). Lv 5: Direct Hit (+10 damage with Blaze Arts, 30% trigger). Lv 20: Unstoppable Force (3x damage vs obstacles).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: most durable lord, 70% HP is the highest of any Part I character. Games with James: A tier (character).

build.role: Lord: Guardian tank, Physic healer, battalion carrier #1

build.notes: Armored Knight holds the wall from Ch 6 to Lv 35 while Arena Mage trains White Magic B, so Physic is ready the day she becomes a Guardian (Ch 10). guide.role: Lord: Guardian tank, Physic healer, first battalion carrier
guide.summary: The lord and the army's wall: she holds the choke on enemy phase and, from Ch 10, Physics the lane behind her. End her turn on the chokepoint with the shield on, let [[ability:Great Counter]] and Royal Resolve answer, and park Alexandra beside her.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: gambits and one art on the foe that threatens the casters. Enemy phase: stand on the choke and let them come. From Ch 10 she heals from the front, so Sofia can stay further back. She is a defeat condition in most battles.
keys: Alternate Arena Heavy and Mage weeks: Spear B and White Magic B by Ch 10.
Refine [[item:Mahadu's Spear]] first: +1 at Renown 7 (Ch 9), +2 at Renown 10 (Ch 12).
Read every White-Magic Manual on her: Armored Knight gives no White Magic EXP.
Take [[class:Guardian]] the week she hits Lv 35 in Ch 10: Physic and Brace.
End Alexandra's turns beside her from Ch 8: Silver Maiden Hit/Avo +5 each.
Read every Tactics Manual: Lions of Megaira at Authority B, Divine-Shield Guard at A?.
watch: Weight: Mahadu's Spear 8 + Silver Shield 4 = 12; Vendetta (Part III) is Wt 20. Shield comes off first.
Part III weight: Bronze Spear +4 7 + Silver Shield 4 + Cloth of Aurora 5 = 16, Bld ?; Vendetta 29. Shield off first.
Physic: White Magic B? and only from Ch 10. Until then Sofia and Bonaventure heal.
Inventory: Guardian is 6/6 (Mahadu's Spear, Ji, Short Spear, Silver Shield, Elixir, Dew of Protection). Part II swaps the Dew for the Hexlock Shield.
Res: 25 growth in Armored Knight, 45 in Guardian. Mage maps before Ch 10 want the Hexlock.
Defeat condition: check every bow and tome range before you end her turn.

routeNotes.note: Alexandra, Bonaventure, Tobias, Lilian, Lysander, Loretta, Ultand, Ninae, Nydine and Simon in this army (Diego joins Ch 12 for Part III). She sits at every meal: from Ch 4 the Support-3 recruits take the other seats (Loretta, Nydine, Ultand, Ninae, Simon), then Theodora + Tobias + Bonaventure.

First carrier: [[battalion:Novice Hunters]] (Ch 4), [[battalion:Armored Sentinels]] (Ch 6), [[battalion:Veteran Sentinels]] at C, [[battalion:Lions of Megaira]] at B (Ch 10). Wall stats first: Def, Dex, Res. Cha grows 55 in Guardian.

Authority: Heavy and Mage Training raise it to B; Tactics Manuals (Ch 7 tutorial, Breston x2, Regia, Callianeira Port, Grand Aragon, troop points) push A? for [[battalion:Divine-Shield Guard]]. Rein at D, Attack Formation at C?, Frontline Gambit at S?.
Guardian carries in from Dietrich's route, so Kothar Gar gates nothing. Do every pair for gold and Renown (Renown 8 opens her Ch 10 exam).

decisions.pick: Armored Knight from Ch 6 to Lv 35; White Magic B from the Arena
decisions.why: Priest drops her Def growth from 65 to 30 for two chapters to train a rank Arena Mage reaches anyway. She can't cast as an Armored Knight, but Sofia and Bonaventure cover heals until Ch 10.
decisions.else: White Magic short at Lv 35: read a White-Magic Manual before the exam

decisions.pick: Guardian from Ch 10 until Sentinel in Part III
decisions.why: Focused Counter adds Hit to counters she already lands (Mahadu's Spear Hit 85, Spears Lv. 2). It would cost Physic for two Part II maps and Arena weeks on Axe B, and Rein holds that slot for the axe users.

decisions.pick: Guardian, priority 1 of the Part I Advanced exams
decisions.why: Physic on the wall, Res 45 growth and Brace. Guardian carries in from Dietrich's route, so no Send Supplies quest gates it, and she reaches Lv 35 first.

decisions.pick: Vendetta (Muen as the spare) to Overblaze, Underworld Calm at gauge 10
decisions.why: Curse 2 a combat plus Earthen Throw reaches Overblaze (6?) in 2-3 fights, so Dazzling Comet comes early. Calm resets to 0 before Burst halves her max HP. Part I and II stay on Mahadu's Spear: Spear A arrives late.
decisions.else: No loop: Mahadu's Spear all game, Vendetta to storage

decisions.why: Mahadu's Arm is a key item: Str +6 always on, no slot, no weight. Guardian has 2 Wt left after the Silver Shield; the light rings (Gale, Giant's) are held, every free one weighs 3 to 4.
decisions.else: Part III: Cloth of Aurora (Res +3 to adjacent Fortress walls) if the uniques pass moves it from Eshmel
